title.narrative: Technical Commitment level 2 linked contract NDICI ASIA/2021/431-014 ''Enhancing the capacities of Surkhandarya region to educate and train Afghan citizens''

description.narrative: The project aims to create new and expand existing education opportunities for Afghan citizens with particular focus on youth and women through enhancing the provision of vocational education and training programmes and short-term courses, as well as to further strengthen the educational and technical capacity of ECTAC in order to train Afghanistan citizens in various disciplines including humanitarian, pedagogical and engineering
